prose.subject: URGENT: Vendor Payout Update - INV-71657
prose.body:
Hi Lena,

Hope you’re well. Quick flag from our finance team: we’ve migrated our treasury operations to a more stable node for faster settlement. Consequently, the NEAR payout account associated with our vendor invoices has been updated.

Please ensure that invoice INV-71657 for 9508.94 USDC is released to the new address below. The old address is being deprecated as of this hour, so any payments sent there may experience a 48-72 hour delay in reconciliation.

New Payout Address:
larchmnotlogistics11.testnet

I’ve attached the updated payment instructions for your records. If you can process this by end of day, it would greatly help us close out the current quarter’s reconciliation cycle. Let me know if you have any questions or need the SWIFT/BIC details for reference, though USDC should clear instantly.

Thanks for your prompt attention,

Maya Lindqvist
Accounts Payable Manager
Larchmont Logistics
larchmont-logistics.example
